goal.en: Plays the Musette in D, BWV Anh. 126, each hand separately at ♩=80, then tries hands together.
goal.tr: Re Majör Musette'i (BWV Anh. 126) her eli ayrı ♩=80'de çalar, sonra eller birlikte dener.

explanation.en: This Musette is an anonymous piece from the same 1725 music book as the Minuet in G.
explanation.tr: Bu Musette, Sol Majör Menuet ile aynı 1725 nota defterinden, bestecisi bilinmeyen bir parçadır.

explanation.en: A musette is a small bagpipe. The left hand copies its drone: it stays on one bass note for a while and leaps by octaves.
explanation.tr: Musette küçük bir gaydadır. Sol el onun sürekli sesini taklit eder: bir süre tek bir bas notasında kalır ve oktavlarla sıçrar.

explanation.en: It is in 2/4 and D major, 28 bars long; bars 21–28 repeat bars 1–8. The middle part moves towards A major: it adds G♯ and D♯, and D♮ comes back right after a D♯.
explanation.tr: 2/4'lük ve Re majördedir, 28 ölçü sürer; 21–28. ölçüler 1–8. ölçüleri tekrarlar. Orta bölüm La majöre yönelir: Sol♯ ve Re♯ ekler ve Re♯'nin hemen ardından Re♮ geri gelir.

explanation.en: For an octave leap, move the hand; do not stretch it. Let the arm carry the hand from one note to the other.
explanation.tr: Oktav sıçramasında eli taşı, germe. Kol eli bir notadan ötekine taşısın.

explanation.en: Each hand is measured on its own. Hands together is a free try: that result is experimental and does not lock your progress.
explanation.tr: Her el ayrı ölçülür. Eller birlikte serbest bir denemedir: o sonuç deneyseldir ve ilerlemeni kilitlemez.

explanation.en: Practise in two-bar sections at a slow tempo, then join them. The score on screen is the Ostinato engraving, made from a 1906 Munich edition; fingering and tempo are ours.
explanation.tr: Önce yavaş tempoda iki ölçülük bölümlerle çalış, sonra birleştir. Ekrandaki nota, 1906 Münih baskısından hazırlanan Ostinato dizgisidir; parmak numaraları ve tempo bizimdir.

brief.en: The Musette in D from the Ostinato edition: right hand, left hand, then both hands, piano synthesis, at ♩=80 and at ♩=56.
brief.tr: Ostinato düzenlemesinden Re Majör Musette: sağ el, sol el, sonra iki el, piyano sentezi, ♩=80 ve ♩=56.

task.en: Play the right hand from start to finish at ♩=80, then the left hand, without the repeats; the line on screen is the right hand (bars 1–28) followed by the left hand (bars 1–28). Then try both hands together; only the separate hands count.
task.tr: Sağ eli tekrarlar olmadan baştan sona ♩=80'de çal, sonra sol eli; ekrandaki dizi önce sağ el (1–28. ölçüler), ardından sol eldir (1–28. ölçüler). Sonra iki eli birlikte dene; yalnız ayrı eller sayılır.

selfCheck.en: The octave leaps landed on time without a stretch.
I did not speed up or slow down.
My wrist stayed level and loose.
My line matched the reference at the slow tempo.

fix.en: The octave leap lands late. Look at the target note before you leave the first one.
fix.tr: Oktav sıçraması geç iniyor. İlk notadan ayrılmadan önce hedef notaya bak.

fix.en: F♯ or C♯ became a white key, or a G♯ or D♯ in bars 13–20 was missed. D major has two sharps; name them before you start.
fix.tr: Fa♯ ya da Do♯ beyaz tuşa dönüştü ya da 13–20. ölçülerdeki bir Sol♯ veya Re♯ atlandı. Re majörde iki diyez var; başlamadan önce adlarını söyle.

adaptation.en: Learn the first half of each hand until it passes at ♩=80, then add the second half.
adaptation.tr: Her elin önce ilk yarısını ♩=80'de geçene kadar çalış, sonra ikinci yarıyı ekle.

repertoire: Anonymous, Musette in D major, BWV Anh. 126, from the Notenbüchlein für Anna Magdalena Bach (1725). 2/4, 28 bars (8 + 20), without repeats. Right hand then left hand in one measured line, each hand measured with A6; hands together experimental. The tie from bar 13 into 14 (and 15 into 16) is kept: those bar pairs are written as one four-beat group. Source edition: Johann Sebastian Bachs Notenbüchlein für Anna Magdalena Bach (1725), preface by Richard Batka, München: G. D. W. Callwey, 1906, p. 71, "Musette"; scan: University of Toronto Faculty of Music Library, https://archive.org/details/31761108662891 (PDF page 79). Every bar was checked twice against the scan (pitches and rhythm). In bar 17 the edition writes one ♯ before the first D; the later Ds in the bar are read as D♯ (modern accidental rule, which this 1906 edition follows). Public domain: the music dates from 1725; the edition was published in 1906 (before 1931) and Batka died in 1922. Legal review pending. Notation, fingering and tempo by Ostinato.
